audit.whatIsWrong: phases[N].side read Karma / Skill x6 while content win[N] and packet.levelChart both read Orianna, Karma, Karma, Karma, Orianna, Orianna, Orianna. All seven rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: The content layer agrees with the packet chart, so the full-layer sides are the wrong copy. The whys were generic Orianna boilerplate that did not describe Karma winning levels 2-5 at all.
audit.corrected: Sides moved onto the content chart and every why rewritten to match its new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose ignored Mantra entirely and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' Focused Resolve.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat at every rank; Mantra is 40/38/36/34s and is reduced by every damaging spell Karma lands (Gathering Fire). Level 6 is Orianna's spike because Karma's R is only Mantra charges she already had at level 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers corrected and the level 6 flip explained by Shockwave (110s at rank 1) against an R that adds no new effect.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit; Do's and Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes and generic template lines.
audit.why: The decisive interactions are: Mantra Inner Flame out-ranges your 815 Q at 950 and adds a delayed cataclysm; Focused Resolve roots only if the tether survives, so line of sight and the 675 range break it; Mantra E gives shield plus haste. Your E (9s) covers the Mantra Q; your R is the only thing she cannot shield out of.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the real ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Mantra Focused Resolve healing Karma through extended trades.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal; the heal is on the empowered tether, so it decides long exchanges specifically.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early now names the Mantra W heal and the Grievous Wounds timing.
All flagged fields rewritten with she/her.
